facts.value: Seven-opening sluice, 长春园's east outlet to the 清河

facts.label: What it was
facts.value: a sluice outside the garden walls

facts.label: In 1860
facts.value: in use; stood until the 1950s-60s (S06 via repo CC19)

facts.label: Where
facts.value: repo CC19 / G20 on S01 (guess, C; the plan shows 5 openings); today's neighbourhood name 七孔闸 (osm node 13403268064, historic=yes) at 116.31353, 40.01093, 180 m ESE, supports the east side at this latitude

facts.label: Note
facts.value: [j80:7b] 經長春園出七空閘東入清河; [j83:3b] 又東出七空閘灌溉稻田. 贾 2024 lists 长春园东墙出水闸 AND 七孔闸: two outlets on that wall.
